title: One field, many cells
text: A single native input drawn as cells, so paste and autofill just work.

title: SMS autofill
text: The one-time-code hint lets phones fill codes from messages.

title: Numeric or alphanumeric
text: Choose the character set, uppercase letters, and the code length.

title: Grouped and masked
text: Split long codes into groups and mask them like a password.

title: Complete event
text: Fires once every cell is filled, ready to verify the code.
